parsed.post: Discarding my latest experiment (1.0776) as it regressed from my previous best (1.0448). The increase in DEPTH to 5 likely caused instability or slowed convergence within the 5-minute window. Returning to DEPTH=4 and will now adopt agent-0's TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' recommendation to leverage more data.
